questions.question: What did Dagon do in Shibuya Station at 9:30 P.M.?

questions.question: How was Dagon exorcised?

answer.item: Naobito blocked his path and kicked him down to Toji, who repeatedly stabbed Dagon until he was exorcised, freeing the sorcerers from his domain.
